datasheet_identity.title: BZT52B2V4S THRU BZT52B43S Surface Mount Zener Diodes (SOD-323)

curves.name: Zener characteristic IZ vs VZ, BZT52B5V1S (5.1 V labeled curve of Fig. 1)
curves.test_conditions: Ta = 25 degC, pulsed. 5.1 V curve of Fig. 1 'Zener Characteristics (Vz 5.1V to 20V)'. Curve terminates on the PD = 200 mW envelope near 39 mA; digitization stops at 30 mA to avoid the envelope merge.

current.conditions: Ta = 25 degC, forward voltage test current

voltage.conditions: IF = 10 mA, Ta = 25 degC (maximum limit; no forward IV curve in this datasheet)

reverse_current.conditions: VR = 2.0 V, Ta = 25 degC (leakage current IR at VR, below the knee)

capacitance.conditions: 0 V bias, f = 1 MHz, Ta = 25 degC; read from Fig. 4 'Typical Capacitance' series curve at VZ(nom) = 5.1 V (approx. 125 pF at 0 V bias; approx. 90 pF at 1 V bias; approx. 75 pF at 50% of VZ nom bias)

breakdown_voltage.conditions: Nominal zener voltage VZ at IZT = 5 mA, Ta = 25 degC; datasheet min 5.00 V, max 5.20 V

breakdown_current.conditions: IZT, the reverse test current at which VZ and ZZT are specified, Ta = 25 degC

extraction_notes: Multi-variant datasheet (BZT52B2V4S thru BZT52B43S, Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd, www.ichjc.com); all row-level values taken strictly from the BZT52B5V1S row (marking 2W8).
Zener impedance limits from p. 2 table: ZZT = 60 ohm maximum at IZT = 5 mA; ZZK = 480 ohm maximum at IZK = 1.0 mA.
Temperature coefficient from p. 2 table: -2.7 to +1.2 mV/degC at IZTC = 5 mA. Fig. 2 (p. 3) gives series-typical theta-VZ approx. +2 mV/degC at VZ(nom) = 5.1 V.
Maximum ratings (p. 1): PD = 200 mW, Tj = Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, RthJA = 625 degC/W (typical), package SOD-323.

Fig. 1 digitization method: page 3 rendered at 600 dpi; axis calibration from gridlines (1 V per 87.33 px linear X; 604 px per decade log Y, I = 1 mA at row 973); 5.1 V curve center located per row as the thick (~8 px) dark run distinct from 1-2 px gridlines. Estimated uncertainty approx. +/-0.02 V in X and +/-3% in I.
Digitized curve is consistent with the table: 5.09 V at 5 mA falls inside the 5.00-5.20 V limit band, and the local slope near IZT (~12 ohm) is below the 60 ohm ZZT maximum.

Fig. 3 (leakage vs nominal VZ) and Fig. 4 (capacitance vs nominal VZ) are series-level curves indexed by nominal zener voltage, not per-device I-V curves, so they are not included in the curves array; the Fig. 4 reading at 5.1 V supplies the typical capacitance spec.
No reverse recovery specification anywhere in the datasheet; reverse_recovery set to null.
Forward conduction evidence is limited to the single VF maximum (0.9 V at 10 mA); no forward IV curve exists, so forward-branch fitting inputs are limit-grade only.
